title: Customers first. The numbers follow.
body: Product is the customer's voice inside the company. Solve a real problem and the business metrics follow, usually faster than when you chase them directly.

title: Design for the moment of doubt
body: I once assumed fewer clicks would lift conversion in insurance. Experiments and customer calls said otherwise: people wanted help understanding what they were buying. Complex products need help at the moment of decision, not fewer taps.

title: Charters, not tickets
body: Every product manager on my team owns an outcome and a metric they can move. Monthly check-ins run from a written guide, and hard feedback is prepared on paper before the conversation.
